description: List what changed the workspace's credits in [from,to), oldest first: one row per charge to this workspace (at, priceKey, credits, paidFrom balance or overage, operationKind and operationId from the charge reference) and per credit grant to the shared balance. totals cover the whole range; otherWorkspaces is the amounts the billing owner's other workspaces charged to or added to the same balance, with no workspace count, names or IDs (tracking refreshes there spend it too), so balanceChange matches the change in socialseal_get_workspace_balance. A range is at most 31 days; pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page. Free; read it to reconcile a balance change with the calls that caused it.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page, unchanged.

from.description: Start of the range, inclusive (ISO 8601 with offset).

to.description: End of the range, exclusive; defaults to now. At most 31 days after from.

workspaceId.description: Workspace selected for the original request, whose credits pay for it.

name: socialseal_get_credit_activity

fieldPaths.description: Deduplicated JSON pointer patterns (* matches array elements) into source payloads before text truncation and existing structuredContent.result or structuredContent. Original structured values are unchanged.

title: Read credit activity
